name: recurly
description: Reads Recurly accounts, subscriptions, invoices, transactions, catalog, usage, exports, preview resources, and related V3 API data; models typed reverse-ETL mutations for official POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints.

risk.read: external Recurly API reads can expose account, billing, invoice, subscription, usage, and transaction data; direct preview reads are fixed-path and redacted
risk.write: typed Recurly reverse ETL mutations for accounts, billing, subscriptions, invoices, catalog, usage, coupons, exports, and related lifecycle resources
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, explicit approval, execute; destructive lifecycle actions require destructive confirmation; each Recurly mutation receives a stable per-record Idempotency-Key across automatic retries
